name: Lampsa Hellenic Hotels S.A.
summary: Lampsa Hellenic Hotels S.A. operates and manages hotels in Greece, Cyprus, and Serbia. The company operates the Great Britain and the King George hotel located in Athens; Hyatt Regency and Mercure Excelsior Hotel located in Belgrade; and MGallery Collection located in Greece. Lampsa Hellenic Hotels S.A. was founded in 1874 and is headquartered in Athens, Greece.
